nodes.title: Second buyer walkthrough on the dev server (NBFC collections at 1440, hospital chain at 390, the seeded workspace at both): 136 steps, 7 failed (3 walk-script selectors, 2 no seeded recording, 2 scripted assistant gave no Review button), 0 sideways scroll; 18 web frictions fixed, 13 routed to the server.
nodes.method: Playwright on Chromium (fake microphone, devsim runtime, scripted Operator model), fresh Postgres 16; every screenshot opened; 12 new browser flows failed on the old build and pass on the new one.
nodes.not_verified: The assistant's real replies, her real voice, recording playback, a real number search or DND answer.

nodes.title: Billing lines read inrMilli; invoice.get sends costInrMilli, so every line showed ₹0.00 under a non-zero total (seeded: ₹10.92 total).
nodes.tried: The Billing card mapped byComponent lines with l.inrMilli ?? l.inr_milli.
nodes.broke: Every line rendered ₹0.00; the lines did not add up to the total. Fixed in web; a flow now sums the lines against invoice.get.

nodes.title: Tools-tab switches for "End the call herself" and "Connect to a person" that change nothing at runtime.
nodes.tried: end_call and transfer were listed in TOOL_INFO as toggles; templates leave them off.
nodes.broke: The runtime always grants ending after a goodbye (compile.ts markerRules; vpvoice/conversation.py:447 skips both) and hands over on handOff.when, so an OFF switch told the buyer she cannot hang up (must-be C) while she can. The web now states both as they work; tool.attach still accepts the two names (agents-tools test) and agent-config still lists them as tools.

nodes.title: A buyer-facing refusal that names a server setting: "set VP_TELEPHONY_LIVE=1 with credentials on the server".
nodes.tried: TelephonyDisabled (product/server/modules/campaigns/telephony.ts:43) puts the operator hint in the tool reason.
nodes.broke: Number search on the Numbers page showed it verbatim. The web now rewrites any refusal naming a VP_ setting (plainReason); API and MCP callers still get the raw text until the server says it plainly with a code.

nodes.title: Tab strips that wrap to two rows on desktop and clip on phone with no scroll sign.
nodes.tried: Tabs scrolled sideways below 900 px with the scrollbar hidden, and wrapped above it.
nodes.broke: Phone: the fourth agent tab read "Objec" with nothing saying more exist (round 1 leftover). Desktop beside the assistant: "Versions" and Settings' "Integrations / Activity" fell to a second row. Replaced by one row with a fade and arrow buttons on the hidden side.

nodes.title: Should launch checks warn when the list's preferred languages are ones the agent does not speak? (Deccan Fincorp: Kannada, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu contacts; an agent with Hindi, English, Hinglish; no warning.)
nodes.closes_when: launchBlockers (product/server/modules/campaigns/index.ts:76) returns a warning with counts and a fix link to the agent's languages, or a decision records why not.

nodes.title: Nothing checks that an agent's per-contact facts (emi_amount, emi_due) have a matching list column ("EMI amount", "Due date"), before launch or at import.
nodes.closes_when: source.preview or launchBlockers names each per-contact fact with no matching attribute.

nodes.title: Build-your-own part prices are in US dollars ($ per audio hour, $ per million tokens) while stack cards are ₹ per minute (must-be A).
nodes.closes_when: Each part in shared/components.ts carries a ₹ figure at the money module's rate, with USD only in the basis note.

nodes.title: Publish shows no diff and nothing about what goes live (stack, last practice result, change since the previous version); sharpened must-be 15 asks for an explicit publish with a diff.
nodes.closes_when: version.publish describe (product/server/modules/agents/index.ts:502) returns detail rows the approval sheet already renders.

nodes.title: brief.today needsTap items carry no requester, so an approval cannot say who asked (the assistant, a teammate, the person).
nodes.closes_when: product/server/modules/operator/tools.ts:41 selects the actor type and name; the sheet shows it.

nodes.title: Activity says "saved a campaign draft: <audience name>": subjectOf picks the first matching input key (audienceId) rather than the created campaign; publishing reads "asked for approval to make a change".
nodes.closes_when: product/server/subject.ts:8 prefers the created record for *.draft and names the tool in proposal lines.

nodes.title: "VP" is still shown to buyers in money copy (estimate basis, Billing price note and statement note): round 1's S3.
nodes.closes_when: product/server/modules/money/money.ts:59,72,214 and money/index.ts:55 say Vyakti; the web no-"VP" guard is extended to server strings that reach people.

nodes.title: Billing is a usage statement only: no tax invoice, GSTIN, payment method or receipts, which enterprise buyers ask for first (must-be 19).
nodes.closes_when: Owner decides the billing documents for v1 once price is set; invoice.get grows them.

nodes.title: Numbers does not state KYC documents, typical time and monthly price per series before a search (sharpened must-be 16), even with telephony off.
nodes.closes_when: number.search (product/server/modules/campaigns/index.ts:442) or a series list returns the checklist, time and price.

nodes.title: call.search / call.get return agent_version_id without agent name or version number, so the call log cannot show the version (must-be 13) without N+1 reads.
nodes.closes_when: product/server/modules/calls/tools.ts:184 joins agent name and version number.

nodes.title: Today shows spend (₹0.09 of practice calls) while the wallet is ₹0 and Empty: what does test spend draw on?
nodes.closes_when: A decision: tests draw on the wallet, a test allowance, or nothing; Today and Billing say which.

nodes.title: Every curated stack card says "No sample recorded yet": a buyer cannot hear a voice before building an agent.
nodes.closes_when: One recorded sample per curated stack (VM, within the Vertex rate rule) is attached to stack.list.

events.title: Web: second buyer walkthrough, 18 web fixes (billing lines, plain server refusals, one-row tabs, honest tools tab, growing brief fields, calls list on phone, campaign agent/list, hear-her-first, stack disclosure, DND card, approvals, Today, activity, roles); 13 server items routed
